condition.narrative: Should contribute directly to results for children as outlined in the UNDAF, national results and/or UNICEF Strategic Plan and within the scope defined in the CPD, CPAP, OMP or other agreed upon programme documents

title.narrative: During the reporting period, about 150,000 individuals reached by government cash-transfer, and estimated 38.8% vulnerable children. Government continued with its existing social protection assistance, mostly in support of families of martyrs, vulnerable households, people/children with disabilities and women-headed households.
National human rights institutions are supported
Routine measurement and reporting on child poverty is nationally owned
Extent to which national and local governance capacities for reducing child poverty at local level, have been enhanced with UNICEF support, including in humanitarian settings
Extent to which international and private sector resources for children have been mobilised with UNICEF support
Level of support to the implementation of recommendations issued by the Committee on the Rights of the Child
Extent to which transformative child rights policies and programmes that promote gender equality have been identified and financed with UNICEF support

Extent to which social sector budgets (including social protection) have been strengthened with UNICEFs support, for greater and better investments in children, including in humanitarian and fragile contexts
